missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Крыша' is the feminine nominative subject of the possession frame 'у дома'. 'Красная' is the agreeing feminine adjective. A clean descriptive sentence.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Крыше' is the prepositional after 'на' showing where the birds are. This contrasts with the accusative 'на крышу' used for motion.
Strategic focus: Genitive with с. 'Крыши' is the genitive after 'с' showing motion off a surface. 'С крыши' is the natural counterpart to 'на крышу' for coming down. A common winter sentence.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Крышу' is the accusative direct object of 'ремонтируем'. 'Старую' agrees in the feminine accusative. A practical household task.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with под. 'Крышей' is the instrumental after 'под' showing position beneath. 'Ласточки' is the nominative plural subject of 'живут'. A natural locative description.
Strategic focus: Dative with к. 'Крыше' is the dative after 'к' showing direction toward. 'Лестницу' is the accusative object. A concrete, practical scene.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Крыш' is the genitive plural after 'много', with the bare stem and no ending. 'Зелёных' agrees in the genitive plural. A clear genitive-plural model.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Крыши' is the nominative plural subject of 'блестят'. 'Красные' agrees in the plural, and 'на солнце' adds the setting. A vivid descriptive line.
Strategic focus: Dative with по. 'Крыше' is the dative after 'по' showing motion over a surface. 'Барабанить по крыше' is a vivid way to describe rain drumming on the roof.
